'''Theta Sector''' was a sector in both the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] and [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Stars]].

Notable locations in Theta Sector were [[Superlaser Fire Control]] and the [[Superlaser Simulator]].
